v.q: Which storage is shared by many servers as a mounted file system?
v.w: EFS is managed NFS that many instances and containers mount at once. EBS attaches to one instance.

v.q: Which storage is a disk for one instance in one zone?
v.w: An EBS volume lives in one availability zone and attaches to an instance there.

v.q: What protects S3 data from an accidental delete?
v.w: Durability covers hardware loss, not your own mistakes. Versioning keeps earlier versions to restore.

v.q: How consistent is S3 after a successful write?
v.w: The next read or list sees the write or delete.

v.q: Which class suits data with unpredictable access?
v.w: It moves objects between tiers by itself for a small monitoring fee.

v.q: What does a lifecycle rule do?
o: Moves or deletes objects by age
v.w: It can move objects to cheaper classes, expire them, and clean old versions.

v.q: Why use a presigned URL for uploads?
o: The file bypasses your API servers
It removes the need for a bucket
v.w: The client talks to S3 directly, so large files never load your servers.

v.q: Which setting should a presigned URL have?
v.w: Whoever holds the URL can do the allowed action, so keep it to minutes.

v.q: Which control stops a bucket policy from making data public?
v.w: It overrides mistaken policies and ACLs, so switch it on for the account.

v.q: What does a deny on aws:SecureTransport false do?
o: Rejects requests that do not use TLS
v.w: Plain HTTP requests are refused, so data is always sent encrypted.

v.q: Which mode cannot be shortened even by the root user?
v.w: Compliance mode holds the retention until it ends. Governance mode can be bypassed with a permission.

v.q: What does Vault Lock protect against?
v.w: Even administrators cannot delete locked recovery points, which blunts ransomware.

v.q: What is true of an EBS snapshot?
o: It is a full copy every time
It lives only on the instance
v.w: Only changed blocks are stored after the first snapshot, and it can be copied to other regions or accounts.

v.q: What happens to instance store data when the instance stops?
v.w: Use it only for caches and scratch space.

v.q: Which is a hidden S3 cost in a versioned bucket?
v.w: Old versions keep adding storage until a lifecycle rule expires them.

v.q: How can you avoid NAT gateway charges for S3 traffic?
v.w: Traffic to S3 then stays on the AWS network, so it does not pass the NAT gateway.
